description: A man lay in a sealed room for four days. He could not see, hear, taste, smell, or feel anything. Then he began to hear his dead wife.

In 1983, a group of deeply religious scientists tried to cut off the five senses, so a human mind could reach God. The volunteer was an elderly man who said he had nothing left to live for. Soon he was hearing the dead, and they knew private things only the scientists' own families could have known.
A Scroll Kaos paper-cutout horror story, told in our own words. Watch until the very end.
